# Immutable MLOBS001 v1 compatibility evidence

Six independent fixtures freeze full exact source/calibration/correlation context,
known and unknown attribution, successful N=0, failed/unavailable N=0, fractional
coordinates, confidence and a future extension. `reference_v1.py` describes their
one-time independent construction and refuses replacing existing files. Tests
never run it or generate expected bytes from production code. A byte mismatch is
a regression. Existing storage fixtures are unchanged.
